title: rafnia angulata subsp. thunbergii
intro: Rafnia angulata subsp. thunbergii, commonly known as Rafnia, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rafnia include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Rafnia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and are responsible for its medicinal properties.
